about_desc_1: Pelesir Palembang is a smart travel assistant app designed specifically to help tourists explore the cultural beauty, culinary, and tourism destinations in Palembang City.
about_desc_2: Equipped with Chatbot (TanyaKito), Itinerary Builder, and destination recommendations features, this app is ready to be your travel companion.

help_subheading: Find answers to the most frequently asked questions below.
help_faq_a1: You can go to the Itinerary menu in the bottom navigation, then click the plus (+) button or 'Create New Itinerary'. Fill in your trip details, then add the tourism destinations you want.
help_faq_a2: Of course! You just need to go to the Chatbot menu and type 'culinary recommendation' or 'good places to eat'. TanyaKito will give you the best recommendations based on our data.
help_faq_q3: Why can't I save a destination to Favorites?
help_faq_a3: The Favorites feature requires an account so the data can be saved permanently. Please Login or Register first before pressing the Love button on a destination.
help_faq_a4: You can change the app interface language through the 'Language' menu on the Profile page (preferences).
priv_sec1_desc: We collect basic information when you register, such as your full name and email address. If you use the Map feature or nearby recommendations, we may also ask for permission to access your device's location (GPS).
priv_sec2_desc:
The information we collect is exclusively used to provide a better experience, such as: 
• Personalizing Chatbot (TanyaKito) recommendations. 
• Saving your Itinerary and Favorites list. 
• Optimizing app performance and features.
priv_sec3_desc: Pelesir Palembang highly respects your privacy. We DO NOT sell, rent, or trade your personal data to any third party for advertising purposes. We only use third-party services such as Supabase (for database) and Google Maps (for maps) with high security standards.
priv_sec4_desc: Your passwords and sensitive information are encrypted and stored securely. However, we recommend that you use strong passwords and do not share them with anyone.
priv_sec5_desc: You have full rights over your account. You can update your profile at any time, or request the deletion of your account and associated data by contacting our Support team.
priv_footer: By using the Pelesir Palembang app, you agree to this Privacy Policy.
